Class SimulationRun

java.lang.Object
simu.dao.SimulationRun
public class SimulationRun extends Object
Plain Java object that mirrors a row of the simulation_run table plus the related metric rows. Used as the carrier between SimulationRunDAO and the rest of the application (Controller, future "history" UI screen, …).
